name: FreeApp AI Base Inference Model
ownership: FreeApp AI owns the inference-provider interface, routing, prompt orchestration, and runtime configuration. The initial model weights are an independently hosted open-weight upstream model, not a newly trained foundation model.
limitations: This small model is a bootstrap baseline, not a claim of ChatGPT-level reasoning or coding performance.
Use a host with at least 4 GB RAM for initial testing; more memory is recommended for concurrency.
The model artifact is downloaded by the host at setup and is not bundled into the Android APK.
